triggers.name: new_records_polling
triggers.title: New records
triggers.description: New records in a data table
triggers.help: Use this trigger to retrieve new records created since the last time the recipe was triggered, up to a maximum of 1000 records per batch.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table_id
input.label: Data table
input.hint: {{#if input.table_id}} You can view your selected data table here . {{/if}} {{#if !input.table_id}} Select a data table. {{/if}}

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get new records since given date/time, up to 30 days ago. Leave empty to get new records since one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of records to fetch in each batch. Default is 200.

input.name: output_format
input.label: Choose the desired output format
input.hint: Go to our documentation page to learn more.

properties.name: op_set_default
properties.label: Operand
properties.visible_if: parentInput.field_id && (input[parentInput.field_id] === 'number_set' || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'integer_set'                      || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'string_set' || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'date_set' ||                      input[parentInput.field_id] === 'date_time_set' || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'relation_set')

properties.name: value_default
properties.label: Value
properties.visible_if: parentInput.field_id && (input[parentInput.field_id] === 'string' || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'file'                      || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'id' || input[parentInput.field_id] === 'string_set') && !(parentInput.op_default === 'isnull' || parentInput.op_default === 'isnotnull') &&                      !(parentInput.op_boolean === 'isnull' || parentInput.op_boolean === 'isnotnull') && !(parentInput.op_boolean === 'istrue' ||                      parentInput.op_boolean === 'isfalse')

properties.name: value_relation
properties.label: Record ID
properties.hint: Provide the corresponding record ID from the linked table. A valid record ID follows the format of a 128-bit UUID, for example: e04b77b7-31d0-4602-92ee-505270baaf52 .

properties.name: value_relation_in
properties.label: Record ID
properties.hint: Provide the corresponding record ID from the linked table seperated by comma. For example: b2skf-jdjwkdk-wjfi,b2skf-jdjwkdk-fifo To find Record ID, Go to Data table -> hidden columns -> select record …
